purpose: Teach: マタイ/カンジ/エッセンス/面々/国崎/土屋/大森/樋口

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、慈善活動はマタイ伝の精神に倣え
lines.en: Our company will follow the spirit of charitable work — modeled on the Gospel of Matthew.
lines.style: Measured, declarative opening. Crisp consonants on key words. Formal register — this is directive, not discussion. Slight pause after the dash to let the reference land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人にカンジ、つまり漢字書き取りを徹底させます
lines.en: Yes. We'll make kanji writing practice mandatory for all new hires.
lines.style: Brisk, professional acknowledgment. Clean attack on 'Yes.' Methodical delivery — each clause distinct, showing he's taking notes mentally. Respectful but efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、製品のエッセンス、つまり本質を社員に共有しろ
lines.en: Our company will share the essence — the true nature — of our products with every staff member.
lines.style: Formal, deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'essence' to signal its importance. The parenthetical explanation delivered with quiet precision. Authority tempered with clarity — he wants to be understood.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営陣面々で月一会議を実施します
lines.en: Understood. The management team will hold monthly meetings on this.
lines.style: Efficient, assured. Rapid acknowledgment. Shows he's already thinking through implementation. Neutral tone — reporting back, not questioning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、国崎工場の生産性を上げろ
lines.en: Our company needs to raise productivity at the Kunisaki factory.
lines.style: Sharp, direct command. No softening. Kunisaki gets its own weight. The instruction lands like an order. Composed but unmistakably firm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新任の土屋部長と連携を取ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate with the new department head, Tsuchiya.
lines.style: Quick, action-oriented. 'Yes' clipped and immediate. Shows he's already mapping the next step. Professional, forward-moving — no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術顧問の大森博士にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Our company will seek guidance from Dr. Omori, our technical advisor.
lines.style: Formal, respectful framing. 'Dr. Omori' receives clear articulation — this is someone of standing. Declarative, not negotiable. The tone suggests deference to expertise while maintaining authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規開拓の樋口エリアにチームを派遣します
lines.en: Understood. We'll deploy a team to the Higuchi area for new market development.
lines.style: Closing statement — efficient and complete. Clipped 'Understood.' Then fuller, deliberate pacing on the operational detail. Shows execution is underway. Professional finality.
